themes.name: Agentic AI in research
themes.description: Articles discussing AI agents capable of performing research tasks autonomously or semi-autonomously, including their development, safety, and application in workflows.

themes.name: AI coding assistants
themes.description: Content focused on AI tools that assist in the coding process, including their use, security implications, and potential for introducing bugs.

themes.name: AI research tools
themes.description: Articles reviewing, comparing, or announcing new AI-powered tools designed to aid researchers in various aspects of their work.

themes.name: Synthetic users
themes.description: Discussions around the creation and use of AI-generated user representations for testing, simulation, and research purposes.

themes.name: AI for product management
themes.description: Articles exploring how AI can assist product teams in decision-making, ideation, and understanding product development.

themes.name: AI usability testing
themes.description: Content related to the use of AI in automating or enhancing the process of testing user interfaces and experiences.

themes.name: AI for design & research
themes.description: Articles covering the application of AI in the broader fields of design and research, encompassing tools and methodologies.

themes.name: AI customer insights
themes.description: Content focusing on how AI is used to extract, analyze, and leverage insights from customer data and interactions.

themes.name: AI testing automation
themes.description: Articles detailing the use of AI to automate various stages of testing, from software development to user experience.

themes.name: AI qualitative research

note: Themes identified by analyzing articles from curated sources, Google News, HackerNews, and DEV.to this month.
